name: SOCI 5833
title: Gender, Politics and the State
description: Explores gendered construction of state and politics with attention to changes over time, across cultures and political institutions.  Examines key debates within feminist political and legal theories and third world feminist and post colonialsist theories of the state.  Discusses links between local resistance, immigration, cultural citizenship, international politics, neoliberal discourse, and global economic restructuring.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
